summary: FERC's Secretary corrects the caption and footnote 13 of the E-7 show cause order so Allegheny Electric Cooperative and Wabash Valley Power Association are treated as non-public-utility owners that need not respond.

points.point: The errata removes Allegheny Electric Cooperative and Wabash Valley Power Association from the caption of the EL26-67 order.
points.quote: The caption in the order inadvertently included “Allegheny Electric Cooperative, Inc.” and “Wabash Valley Power Association, Inc.”

points.point: FERC keeps authority to review non-public-utility formula rates through PJM, which must answer for their Tariff provisions.
points.quote: PJM must respond to this order regarding the non-public utilities’ PJM Tariff provisions on file with the Commission.

throughLine.text: Corrects which Transmission Owners must respond to the E-7 show cause order in EL26-67, leaving the directive itself unchanged.
